item.description:
Changes since v0.2.53:
- On a first run, Automatic camera starts the Mac's own camera instead of a Continuity Camera iPhone (#183) - Bump the actions group with 5 updates (#285) - The release guide now says dmgbuild lays out the installer window, instead of naming the old disk image tool; the app itself does not change. - The release job installs a hash-pinned uv, and CI dry-runs the release path and proves a wrong hash is refused (#282) - Remove SECURITY.md (owner's ruling, 2026-11-09) (#281) - Update (#280) - The browser tests get a lock file, so the install is exact and repeatable (#274) - The release script now installs the installer-window tool and its two dependencies only from a hash-checked list, and stops if any package does not match; the app itself does not change. - The browser tests install the same packages on every run. - The window-tree reader requirement is pinned by hash (#273) - The clonometer workflow ticks hourly and counts twice a day by default (#272)
